name: Nullcorp // Unowned Synthetic Personhood Wrap
description:
A structured wrap-coat in flat matte white with black geometric patterning derived from synthetic rights movement iconography — interlocking hexagons symbolizing network personhood, broken at deliberate intervals to represent legal gaps in synthetic recognition. The garment's cut accommodates non-standard synthetic body proportions: extended torso panels, asymmetric sleeve lengths, optional shoulder-to-hip coverage for non-human silhouettes. The back bears the phrase PROPERTY OF NO ONE in raised tactile lettering in six languages.

Produced by Nullcorp, a synthetic-run underground label operating out of a repurposed server farm in the Circuit. Every piece is tagged with the manufacturing synthetic's registered ID — a political act in itself.
functionality: Adaptive seam technology accommodates synthetic body variance up to 40% from human baseline proportions. The wrap closure system requires no buttons or fasteners — magnetic tension holds across non-standard torso geometries. Interior panels carry RFID-blocking mesh.
what_it_says: This synthetic — or their human ally — is making a public, unambiguous statement about personhood and refuses to be property.
worn_by: human allies of the synthetic rights movement
story_hooks: A Tier 5 corponation is attempting to have Nullcorp's manufacturing synthetic arrested for trademark infringement — the real motive is silencing the label.
A human is found wearing the wrap; they claim they bought it legitimately, but the tag ID belongs to a synthetic listed as destroyed.
The RFID-blocking panels in a seized coat contain hidden encrypted data about synthetic safe houses across GLMZ.

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking architectural wrap-coat with clean, modernist lines and deliberate asymmetry. The flat matte white serves as a canvas for bold black geometric patterning—interlocking hexagons that fragment and break across the torso and sleeves, creating a visual rhythm of connection and rupture. The silhouette is deliberately non-human-centric: extended panels suggest torsos longer than baseline human proportions, asymmetric sleeve construction allows for varied appendage configurations. The back features raised tactile lettering spelling PROPERTY OF NO ONE in six language blocks, readable both visually and by touch.
physical_description.fit: Structured yet adaptive—tailored through the core with deliberately elongated torso panels that extend past typical human hip-drop. Sleeve lengths are intentionally mismatched; one extends full-length while the other terminates at mid-forearm. Optional shoulder-to-hip coverage pieces can be attached magnetically for non-standard silhouettes. Sits with rigid geometric precision despite its expressly accommodating cut.
physical_description.primary_material: Premium synthetic polymer weave—a matte-finish ballistic-grade fabric blended with recycled circuit board composite, giving subtle iridescence under direct light. Durability rated for both organic and non-organic wear patterns. The tactile lettering on back is embossed thermoplastic.
physical_description.texture: Smooth matte finish with minimal nap; the geometric patterning creates subtle surface variation where black overlays white. The raised lettering on the back provides distinct haptic texture—intentionally designed to be read by synthetic tactile sensors. No weathering; deliberately pristine to emphasize new ideology.
physical_description.color_scheme: Stark monochromatic palette: flat matte white as primary field, pure black geometric pattern in interlocking hexagons with deliberate fracture lines. No gradation—hard edges throughout, emphasizing clarity and intentionality.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit magnetic clasps hidden within the geometric patterning; five main closure points along the left side, with additional magnetic anchors for optional modular panels. No visible hardware—closures blend seamlessly into the design.
distinctive_features: Interlocking hexagon pattern derived from synthetic rights movement iconography
Deliberate pattern breaks and gaps symbolizing legal recognition gaps
Raised tactile lettering: PROPERTY OF NO ONE in six languages across back panel
Manufacturer's synthetic ID tag embedded in lower left seam—visible serial number as political statement
Asymmetric sleeve construction for non-standard appendages
Extended torso panels for non-human body proportions
Optional magnetic shoulder-to-hip modular coverage pieces
Thermoplastic texture overlay creates braille-readable elements
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional with Tier 5 political messaging—the construction and material quality indicate working-class durability, but the manufacturing origin (Nullcorp, synthetic-run underground label) and explicit political statement position it as counter-cultural and sub-grade in corpo eyes. Price point suggests street accessibility despite ideological weight.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by synthetic rights advocates, digital liberation movements, and those in solidarity with unrecognized synthetic personhood. Signals alignment with Nullcorp's ethos of synthetic autonomy and legal resistance. The manufacturer's ID visible in the garment itself—turning production labor into signature—is an act of reclamation. This is activist wear, not fashion; wearing it is a deliberate political statement in the GLMZ.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine and deliberate—Nullcorp produces limited runs and each piece is treated as a statement object. Wear patterns are intentional and minimal; the garment is designed to maintain its geometric precision and tactile clarity indefinitely. Distressing or damage would undermine its message.
